_note: All assumptions live here so a reviewer can change them and rerun. See docs/TECHNICAL_NOTE.md.
_scale_note: E-tickets are ~3-4% of all bus tickets (Problem 3 brief) => x25 to x33. Women ride free (pink pass) and pass holders are unseen, so the upper bound is raised to x45. mid = x33.
_level_note: load / seats: <0.8 seats likely, <1.0 few seats, <1.8 standing room, above that packed (12 m bus ~35 seated, ~65-70 total).
_conf_note: high: >=60 tickets, or >=15 and the level is the same across the 90% sampling interval; medium: >=15, or >=5 and level stable. Thin cells (<15 tickets) are pooled with the neighbouring half-hours (0.25/0.5/0.25).
_capacity_note: 12 m standard bus: 35 seats, ~70 crush. 9 m DEVI e-bus (routes starting 'D-'): 25 seats, ~45 crush. Per-route scale is capped so the route's weekday p95 load cannot exceed crush capacity: e-ticket share varies by route (new e-buses have far higher QR use).
